svg.title: The three edge kinds in journey_biome.py
svg.desc: Three panels, each a two color band with the boundary drawn by the engine at seed 42. Torn: a sine wave of 44 pixel amplitude with normal noise of sigma 7 smoothed by a 9 pixel average, a deckled tear. Hard: 28 pixel amplitude, noise sigma 1.2, a 5 pixel average, a crisp cut with flat fills on both sides. Catmull: a Catmull Rom curve through three control points, no random numbers at all, used for the sea shore.
svg.text: Three edges, drawn by the engine
amp 44 px, freq 1.7, noise sigma 7, 9 px average
amp 28 px, freq 1.4, noise sigma 1.2, 5 px average
volcano ash over ember; flat fills
the sea shore under the desert
Cross hue boundaries get a hard cut.
Same hue families get a tear.
